description: Canonical registry of approved semantic color combinations. Storybook, Figma documentation, validation, and component code consume this file — combinations must not be derived independently from token descriptions.

body-primary-on-trace.nonColorCue: Text content is legible without color
body-primary-on-trace.notes: Default body text on the primary page surface.

body-primary-on-subtle.nonColorCue: Text content is legible without color
body-primary-on-subtle.notes: Body text on subtly differentiated sections.

body-primary-on-natural.nonColorCue: Text content is legible without color

brand-text-on-trace.nonColorCue: Brand is also expressed through type and voice

sale-text-on-trace.nonColorCue: Sale messaging carries explicit price/discount text
sale-text-on-trace.notes: Sale-colored text on the primary surface.

action-brand.nonColorCue: Actionable role conveyed by control shape and label
action-brand.notes: Brand action — faint surface, brand content and border.

action-sale.nonColorCue: Actionable role conveyed by control shape and label
action-sale.notes: Sale action — faint surface with sale content.

action-trigger-border.nonColorCue: Actionable role conveyed by control shape and label
action-trigger-border.notes: Trigger/tertiary action on a trace surface.

selection-trigger.notes: Selected affordance — trigger border and content on trace.

control-neutral.nonColorCue: Control affordance conveyed by form element shape

feedback-success-banner.nonColorCue: Success icon + explicit confirmation copy required
feedback-success-banner.notes: Success messaging — icon and copy carry meaning.

feedback-info-banner.nonColorCue: Info icon + explicit informational copy required

feedback-natural-banner.nonColorCue: Neutral messaging relies on copy, not color
